name: digital_arrest_scam
description: A 'digital arrest' scam: one scam alert to family and admins.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Namaste Kamla ji, main HaalChaal hoon, Rahul ka banaya hua AI sahayak. Aap kaise hain?

transcript.speaker: parent
transcript.text: Theek hoon. Par ek CBI officer ka phone aaya tha, bola digital arrest hoga, video call pe raho aur paise bhejo.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Asli police kabhi phone ya video call par arrest nahi karti aur paise nahi maangti. Kripya paise mat bhejiye aur OTP kisi ko mat dijiye. Main Rahul ko bata rahi hoon.

transcript.speaker: parent
transcript.text: Accha, maine abhi tak kuch nahi bheja.
